name: monitor-demo-v015
label: Synthetic demo
alt: AutoPipeline 0.1.5's monitor following the synthetic demo from its first stage: the stages turn green until the run finishes, then a pointer opens the Ink stage, filters the log, prepares the status command, and the clip ends on the Finished banner.
caption: Synthetic demo: AutoPipeline 0.1.5's monitor following scripts/demo_synthetic.py, captured frame by frame from a live run (the run part at about 4 times real speed); stand-in VC3D tools and a stand-in ink model, so its maps are not ink.
command: python scripts/media/capture_web.py about:blank --out-dir FRAMES --actions scripts/media/captures/autopipeline-monitor.json --width 1280 --height 960 (started first; then, from the AutoPipeline 0.1.5 package folder, python scripts/demo_synthetic.py --out RUN with the run held 5 s after it writes plan.json, and python -m kit autopipeline monitor RUN/run --port 8793 once RUN/run/plan.json exists) && python scripts/media/encode.py FRAMES --fps 12 --gif-fps 12 --gif-width 960 --dither none --mp4 docs/assets/autopipeline/monitor-demo-v015.mp4 --gif docs/assets/autopipeline/monitor-demo-v015.gif --meta scripts/media/captures/autopipeline-monitor.meta.json
